title: Presentation and challenge session
goals: Explain the mechanism and terminology of presentation and challenge session
Apply the stated procedure to a new case with a traceable result
Identify an assumption or limitation and design a revealing follow-up
vocabulary: Questions testing the basis of a presentation
An example whose selection is justified for the stated purpose
An answer grounded in records or explicit absence

Compare the intermediate evidence with the final statement. Explain why each number or decision follows from the stated inputs. The conclusion belongs to this scenario and procedure; changing the inputs, evaluation population or authority can change what it establishes. Retain the raw record so a later revision can be compared honestly.

guided_practice.title: Trace the worked case
guided_practice.prompt: A presenter shows one perfect output after a20-case study with14 passes. Show the intermediate steps and give the conclusion with its scope.
guided_practice.answer: Teacher explanation: The demonstration is one example; study rate70%. Present aggregate and failures and do not call the best output representative without evidence.

independent_case.title: Apply a new case independently
independent_case.task: Audience asks if result holds on mobile; only desktop was tested. Give an honest answer.
independent_case.answer: Teacher explanation: Mobile behaviour is untested. State desktop scope and propose a new appropriately designed evaluation; do not improvise a positive result.
independent_case.source: primary source W4, first curriculum occurrence

misconceptions: The worked result establishes every future case
A confident response should not replace missing evidence with speculation.
A missing input may be replaced without recording the change
A replacement changes the evidence or contract. Record the change and its justification; do not silently turn unknown into a measured value.
Repeating an assessed case is new independent evidence
A replay checks consistency. An example used for feedback or revision cannot later be described as untouched final evaluation.

blocks.text: Use a short sequence:question, design, primary result, failure, limitation, next question. Answer unfamiliar challenges by locating evidence or stating it is missing.

blocks.text: Before applying the procedure, write its units, denominator or decision boundary where relevant. A partner should be able to repeat each step using the same inputs. If a required input is absent or violates the stated contract, record that condition explicitly instead of quietly replacing it with a convenient value.
